statement: Gersten’s conjecture and virtual compact specialness of one-relator groups. Proves Gersten's conjecture: every finitely generated one-relator group containing no Baumslag–Solitar subgroup $`\mathrm{BS}(m,n)`$, with $`m,n\ne0`$, is word-hyperbolic. It also proves that every word-hyperbolic one-relator group is virtually compact special.
